o: Once their alien diamond making machine gets destroyed, the Solar Opposites must face their greatest challenge yet: living their expensive lives on a budget! When their consumerist habits and expensive hobbies are gone, only their true selves will remain... but will they like who they find? ALSO: The epic story of the people of The Wall has all built to this thrilling and shocking conclusion...

eps.t: The Unfortunate Destruction of the Diamond Making Machine
eps.o: Korvo and Terry's nasty former mission commander moves in down the street and causes all sorts of trouble.
The Solar Opposites are broke so they have a sci-fi estate sale where they accidentally sell Korvo.
Terry and Korvo are stricken with deadly horniness when they visit their condo in the Wooden City.
Jesse and Korvo compete to be crowned the "dad" of their alien family.

eps.t: The Family Memories VHS Mix Tape
eps.o: While the family fights, the Pupa and his robot pal hide in an attic and watch home movies.
Terry needs to up his maturity to save his family from an unlikely set of circumstances.

eps.t: The Realm of Satin and Swords
eps.o: Terry gets into Romantasy books while the replicants try to help Principal Cooke, who has been turned pupa-shaped.
The Pupa uses up the battery on Yumyulack's VR headset.
Terry's new job hits a $%&! snag.
A mysterious space signal is causing the Pupa to transform into murderous creatures.
